messages:
aisha: FYI seeing unexpected S3 PutObject events in prod at 03:12 UTC from role `analytics_viewer`. Objects written to customer-data-prod/sessions/. Not a scheduled job.
samir: any recent RBAC/roles refactor merged to main? that role shouldn't have write perms.
jen: I merged the RBAC refactor PR last night (PR #4823). It touched the analytics role mapping. checking now.
tom: infra-bot, who deployed RBAC-service in prod around 02:45-03:00?
infra-bot: deploy event: RBAC-service v1.6.3 deployed to prod by @jen at 02:50 UTC (pipeline infra/main). CI link: https://ci.redwood/h/4823
samir: can someone pull the effective IAM policy for analytics_viewer? run CloudTrail filter for PutObject by that role session name.
ellen: pulling CloudTrail now, also check S3 server access logs and bucket policy. KMS logs too (weird KMS activity around key rotation yesterday).
jen: policy snippet from the deployed bundle (looks wrong):
```json
"Statement": [
  {
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket","s3:PutObject"],
    "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::customer-data-prod/*"
  }
]
```
jen: that `s3:PutObject` shouldn't be there. I must have squashed a commit incorrectly when resolving merge conflicts. sorry.
sec-oncall: Immediate mitigation options: 1) detach offending policy from `analytics_viewer` role, 2) add explicit Deny for `s3:PutObject` from that role in bucket policy, 3) revoke role membership from prod group. Which is fastest?
aisha: detach role policy + bucket explicit Deny (so even stale creds can't write). also rotate any long-lived credentials attached to that role if present.
samir: commands:
```bash
# detach link
aws iam detach-role-policy --role-name analytics_viewer --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/analytics-prod-access
# apply deny via bucket policy patch
aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket customer-data-prod --policy file://deny-analytics-put.json
```
jen: doing detach now, creating rollback PR to remove s3:PutObject in policy. ETA 8m.
infra-bot: iam.detach-policy job queued by @jen
ellen: CloudTrail shows ~12 PutObject events between 03:11:30 and 03:12:45 from session name analytics_viewer-session-*. S3 server access logs also show writes for those keys. KMS: no decrypt failures; objects appear to be encrypted with the same CMK.
aisha: any data exfil risk? looks like app wrote session blobs (small json). we need object list and confirm no public ACLs.
samir: querying object keys and ACLs now. also running S3 Select on the path for PII keywords.
jen: rollback PR merged and deployed at 03:18 UTC. detach completed at 03:16 UTC. Bucket deny applied at 03:17 UTC.
infra-bot: deploy event: RBAC-service v1.6.4 rolled back to pre-4823 config by @jen at 03:18 UTC.
aisha: post-mitigation: no new PutObject events since 03:18. collecting artifact list (object keys) and snapshotting for audit.
ellen: creating CloudTrail export and S3 access log archive to SEC-GCS for investigation. tagging events with ENGSEC-324.
sec-oncall: opening incident ticket ENGSEC-324: "Unexpected S3 writes by analytics_viewer after RBAC refactor". Assigning action items: 1) policy review gating in CI (owner: jen), 2) add automated smoke check in prod for PutObject by non-writers (owner: samir), 3) KMS logging verification (owner: ellen). ETA for postmortem 48h.
jen: sorry again — will add stricter merge checks and a unit test to validate worst-case policy expansion.
tom: also let's add an automated deny-based testing harness in staging that simulates cross-service role usage.
aisha: thanks team. will follow-up with a short blameless postmortem and timeline. :thumbsup:
